goal: Implement reviewed local AGS evidence contract and trace distinctions for AC-10 through AC-13
acceptance_criteria: Document links cannot claim execution/fault detection
Current evidence validates exact requested source/test/config/dependency identity and artifact content; stale/tampered/missing inputs fail
Named fault requires correct baseline pass and intended behavioral failure; build/setup/timeout invalid
Never execute receipt commands; local hashes do not imply trustworthy execution; ingest only reviewed TestGuard report schema

verification.command: rtk proxy node --import tsx --test scripts/test-assurance/*.test.ts scripts/trace/*.test.ts
verification.expected: Valid current bundle passes; invalid/stale/tampered/build/setup/timeout and pure documentary trace cannot claim fault assurance
